purpose: Review recorded vehicle distance, absolute odometer history, fixed trailing-window mileage and monthly drive detail.
primaryGoal: Understand recorded mileage and its coverage, compare fixed periods, inspect daily/monthly trends and monthly distance per drive without confusing projections with measurements.

routeEvidence.detail: Mileage lazy page mounted under SafeRoute; lazy import at line 157. Source registration is not browser mount proof.

identity.scope: Only MileagePage and its relevant presentation/data dependencies; no sibling page audit.

dataSources.source: Drive-derived recorded lifetime and fixed trailing 7/30/365-day rollups, first/last drive times and counts.
dataSources.queryContract: Vehicle-scoped key; enabled only for a nonempty vehicle ID; AbortSignal forwarded; no page-specific retry/stale override; raw km DTO retained in query cache.
dataSources.trust: historical; refresh failures retain data; missing summary has its own unavailable UI; recording completeness unknown

dataSources.source: Drive-derived daily response envelope selected through safeArray(resp.days); date-only buckets, total_km and nullable end_odometer_km.
dataSources.queryContract: Vehicle and days in key; enablement and cancellation preserved; selected rows are not workspace-range filtered.
dataSources.trust: historical; null odometer days omitted only from odometer chart, not daily distance chart; no inferred coverage

dataSources.queryContract: Vehicle-scoped key; signal and enablement preserved; chart and table use the same rows; loaded-result table export does not promise full-history export.
dataSources.trust: historical; nullable energy/efficiency fields are not displayed or invented; monthly coverage unknown

dataSources.source: Workspace-selected vehicle; saved distance units, locale, precision and chart palette.
dataSources.endpoint: MileagePage does not directly request settings endpoints; only chart palette hook implementation was inspected.
dataSources.queryContract: No duplicate vehicle/date picker. /mileage has range=false and vehicle=true under workspaceScope source. Independent business-year navigation is absent in this inspected page; do not invent, remove or conflate another page's business-year control.

components.name: PageLayout / Section / CardGrid / LayoutCard
components.contract: One allocated-container canvas; six persistent cards, full/half placements; shared header, descriptive help and source notice integration.

components.name: OperationalBrief via MileageBrief
components.contract: Six raw numeric metrics with SI-meter presentation input, locale/precision, source descriptions, status, scope, provenance and unavailable View drives link.

components.name: MetricBar / KVList
components.contract: Three fixed-window comparisons and four activity facts; MetricBar already supports missing values, solid fill and reduced-motion preference.

components.name: EmbeddedChart / ChartContainer
components.contract: Three named charts with stable chartKey, localized two-column accessible table data, 288px desktop/256px mobile sizing and canonical chart renderers. Embedded defaults opt out of export/fullscreen; do not invent existing page toolbar capabilities.

components.name: DataTable
components.contract: analytics:mileage-monthly persistence ID; four sortable columns; value filters, compact rows, pagination and existing loaded-row export behavior; mobileColumns currently selects three fields.

components.name: MileageSourceNotice / QueryError / EmptyState / Skeleton
components.category: Page-specific notice plus canonical feedback barrel
components.contract: Additive refresh error, paused and refreshing messages; source-specific retry without hiding independent cards; contextual loading/empty states.

components.name: FadeIn / NoVehicleSelected
components.contract: Retain entrance preference handling and no-vehicle onboarding branch; implementations not inspected, runtime unverified.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Three charts repeat source notice, fatal/loading/empty branching and chart/table configuration. Existing EmbeddedChart is the correct presentation owner; do not add another chart engine.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Consider local feature decomposition only if necessary, keeping per-source messages and chart identities; no speculative shared component is required.

sourceEvidence.detail: Single CardGrid, no page-local maximum width or packing engine.
Container-measured policy and packed rows; min-w-0 measurement boundary.
Charts use fixed desktop/mobile heights and ResponsiveContainer.

issues.detail: mobileColumns omits dailyAvg, the Distance / drive field. DataTable documents omitted columns as hidden below md at lines 238-248. No mobilePresentation or expanded-detail renderer is supplied by this caller, so the metric is not visible in the mobile table. The ratio-method description does not expose each monthly value.
issues.fix: Use the existing opt-in DataTable mobilePresentation contract with a full-detail field, or retain all four columns with bounded table scrolling. Keep sorting, filters, pagination, persistence and export scope.

sourceEvidence.detail: Localized summary section aria-label; source notices use role=status.
Accessible fallback figcaption/table remains rendered and is exposed in forced colors; page supplies ariaLabel and dataColumns for all three charts.
Description help uses named shared Button, minimum height and Tooltip; Escape blurs trigger. Actual open-state accessibility not tested.

accessibility.limits: Keyboard, focus order/restoration, screen-reader output, target geometry, reduced-motion behavior, tooltip visibility and effective contrast remain unverified. No clean accessibility claim.

states.loading: Six cards retain headings; source-local skeletons; MileageBrief suppresses metric values without stats.
states.empty: Separate odometer/daily/monthly empty messages; monthly table emptyMessage; summary unavailable link to /drives and windows unavailable retry action.
states.error: fatalError replaces only the affected card content; independent sources remain; daily retry appears in both charts and monthly retry in chart/table.
states.refreshFailure: deriveDataState retains payload and MileageSourceNotice adds retry/message; no global error prop passed to PageLayout.
states.offlinePaused: Source-local paused feedback is wired. Initial paused queries may show paused text mentioning last successful data even when there is none.
states.partialUnknown: Coverage explicitly unknown; no invented completeness. Summary missing metrics retain missingReason, but window/chart/table derivations include zero fallbacks.

issues.detail: Paused message always says last successful mileage data is shown. deriveDataState sets isRefreshBlocked for initial paused queries without retained data (dataState.ts:199-214), and the notice props do not include hasData. This can claim retained evidence before a first response.
issues.fix: Pass hasData to this feature notice and localize distinct initial-paused versus retained-paused messages; preserve usable data and independent retry.

issues.detail: Window values default absent fields to zero; daily/monthly distances and drive counts do likewise at lines 150,159-165. Current DTO declares these numeric fields required, so a valid payload is unaffected; malformed/partial responses could become measured-looking zeros, unlike MileageBrief missingReason handling.
issues.fix: Preserve documented genuine zero aggregates and zero-drive division guard. Validate malformed/partial payloads or retain nullable/nonfinite measurements through existing formatter and MetricBar missing-value contracts rather than silently fabricating zero.

visualIssues.detail: Three window bars inherit MetricBar's default gradient fill (MetricBar.tsx:45,86); odometer uses an area gradient at page line 247. No fixed-white/neon text or inline styles were found in the root source. Palette is saved-user-preference driven; a deliberately selected neon palette is not itself a violation.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer existing MetricBar fill=solid for passive comparisons when visually appropriate; assess whether a subdued existing area treatment improves clarity. Preserve semantic series distinctions and saved palette preference; do not reset explicit neon choices.

architectureIssues.detail: Daily bucket date strings use formatDate, which constructs new Date(iso) and renders in browser timezone (dateFormat.ts:65-71). YYYY-MM-DD parses as UTC midnight, so a negative-offset zone can label the preceding day. Both odometer and daily-distance plots and accessible tables inherit this derivation.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse formatDayKey (web\src\lib\dateFormat.ts:255) for date-only bucket labels rather than treating a bucket key as a timestamp. Keep first/last drive timestamp formatting separate and preserve server bucket ordering.

architectureIssues.detail: Mileage hooks cache kilometre-shaped API DTOs (types/analytics.ts:49-102); backend handler emits lifetime_km/total_km (handler.go:152-177). Page explicitly multiplies km by 1000 at display boundary, so current display conversion must not be removed blindly. This existing wire shape does not satisfy the project's all-meters canonical wire aspiration.
architectureIssues.fix: Record for a coordinated backend/types/hooks/consumer SI contract migration, not a page-only rename or extra conversion. Preserve current raw query values and km-to-meter bridge until the endpoint contract is deliberately changed.

priority.first: Correct date-only identity and initial-paused wording; preserve mobile Distance / drive access.
priority.integration: Coordinate SI wire migration separately; no page-only source mutation in Phase0.
priority.visual: Low-priority restrained fill review after functional/trust issues; browser evidence required.

requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Typed canonical-meter stats/daily/monthly DTOs coordinated with useAnalytics and analytics types; nullable odometer, actual zero aggregates, first/last timestamps, envelope selectors and retained cache semantics.
usedBy: Other mileage consumers not enumerated within this assignment
requiredSharedChanges.scopeNote: Reported only; no backend/source change authorized.

competingImplementations.rule: MDC-002 / one existing stats presentation pipeline
competingImplementations.detail: A StatGroup-based MileageSummary duplicates the six metrics, periods and derivations now implemented by OperationalBrief-based MileageBrief. The barrel still exports it, but MileagePage imports MileageBrief as MileageSummary at root line 36. Whether other consumers still need the old export was not inspected.
competingImplementations.fix: Keep the page's current OperationalBrief owner; reconcile other callers before retiring or consolidating the duplicate. Do not replace the shared stats formatter or delete specialist metadata.

No-vehicle onboarding navigation from existing NoVehicleSelected

Named chart accessible table alternatives and source tooltip behavior

dataBehavior: Exactly three mileage queries; disabled with no selected vehicle; encoded vehicle_id and 90-day daily argument
Workspace vehicle remains header-owned; /mileage does not claim workspace date-range ownership
Fixed trailing 7/30/365-day rollups, recorded lifetime facts, daily 90-day source and monthly default 24-month UTC source
Daily average last_30d_km / 30 and annual projection daily average * 365; projection stays explicitly inferred, not measured yearly total
Null end odometer rows omitted only from odometer series; preserve genuine measured zero
Monthly Distance / drive total_km / drive_count, existing zero-count result zero; same monthly rows in chart and table
SI-meter input to shared presentation formatter; existing kilometre wire/cache DTO must not be reinterpreted as meters
Units, locale, precision, chart palette choices, table/chart identities and source order preserved
Historical retained-data rendering, additive refresh/paused messages, independent failures and explicit unknown recording completeness
No business-year navigation exists in this inspected root or rendered mileage-specific components; independent business-year controls elsewhere remain out of scope
